messages:
maria (Sales AE): Pinebridge asked for SIG Q12.5/Q12.6 artifacts. Need to assemble policy + logs + runbook. POC handoff Friday. cc @olivia @jordan

olivia (Security Engineer): We have a CMK rotation policy in Confluence and CloudTrail entries. I can prepare a sanitized export. Any NDA required?

jordan (Sales Eng): Confirm Pinebridge is in Hosted with VPC. If so, we own CMKs. Otherwise if they manage their keys, they must provide proof.

sam (Ops): I can pull CloudTrail events. Command: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-01-01 --end-time 2024-07-01` — will upload to JIRA SEC-EVIDENCE-4510.

sec-approvals (bot): Reminder: production audit exports require an approved SEC-EVIDENCE ticket.

maria (Sales AE): Ticket SEC-EVIDENCE-4510 created. ETA Friday for delivery.

olivia (Security Engineer): I'll redact ARNs and S3 paths. Will attach `rotation_policy.pdf`, `cloudtrail_rotation_sanitized.csv`, and `runbook_snippet.txt`.

jordan (Sales Eng): Provide a 1-pager explaining envelope encryption vs CMK rotation so SIG reviewers don't conflate. I'll draft and attach.

maria (Sales AE): Thanks team, will mark resolved after customer confirms receipt.
